## 4. Real-World Driving Application Scenarios (Tier 4)

1. **Scenario S1: Cold Morning Engine Start & Warmup**
   - *Progression*: Resting vehicle (12.4V, 100°F coolant, 0 RPM) -> starter motor engagement with 10.5V crank dip -> engine ignition to cold-idle (1100 RPM) -> alternator charging to 14.2V -> coolant temperature warmup through cold blue band into optimal green zone (195°F).
   - *Assertions*: 11

2. **Scenario S2: High-Speed Highway Commute with Night Shift**
   - *Progression*: Amber Night Shift palette activation -> Night lighting mode -> 75 mph cruising (2400 RPM) -> Trip computer differential integration (accumulating miles and fuel burned) -> Dynamic fuel economy computation (34.2 MPG) -> Media Player HUD view active.
   - *Assertions*: 8

3. **Scenario S3: Sudden Rapid Tire Deflation & Warning Recovery**
   - *Progression*: Vehicle operating normally in BMW CIC theme -> Sudden puncture on Front-Left tire (33 PSI -> 18 PSI) -> TPMS callout flashes critical red alert -> Master diagnostics badge triggers "SYSTEM ALERT" -> Audible synthesized warning chime fires -> Driver re-inflates tire back to 33 PSI -> Master diagnostics badge recovers cleanly to "ALL SYSTEMS OK".
   - *Assertions*: 6

4. **Scenario S4: Full Interactive Console & Theme Tour**
   - *Progression*: Rotary dial rotation and center push select -> Navigate to Navigation view -> Display theme switched to Audi MMI -> Press `[MEDIA]` hotkey -> Adjust volume using 3-way sport rocker (tilt up + unmute) -> Cycle dual multi-color LED through complete state machine (Bootup -> Pairing -> Tablet -> Phone -> Bootup).
   - *Assertions*: 8

5. **Scenario S5: Engine Dyno Stress & Redline Rev-Limiter**
   - *Progression*: Engine start -> Acceleration through ECO band (2200 RPM) -> Power band (4500 RPM) -> Redline rev limiter surge (6500 RPM) -> Flashing visual redline perimeter alert -> Immediate throttle release -> Smooth needle return to idle (800 RPM) with disengaged redline alert.
   - *Assertions*: 8

## 5. Test Suite Artifacts

1. **In-Browser Test Runner (`test/index.html`)**:
   - High-fidelity dark automotive UI styled with Toyota Camry Optitron cool blue (`#00d2ff`), champagne gold (`#d4c4a8`), and obsidian black.
   - Live dashboard cards displaying total tests, passed, failed, assertions, and execution time.
   - Dynamic tier filter tabs (All, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, Tier 4, Failed Only) with instant keyword search.
   - Expandable test cards with assertion details and error traces.
   - Real-time global error interception trapping `window.onerror`, `unhandledrejection`, and `console.error`.
   - Action buttons to re-run test suite and export results as formatted JSON report.

2. **Core Isomorphic Test Suite (`test/test-suite.js`)**:
   - Universal module (UMD / Global / CommonJS) executing identically in browser and Node.js.
   - Contains specification oracle factory (`createCamryAppMock()`) fully implementing `window.CamryApp` interface contracts.
   - Contains all 65 test definitions across Tiers 1-4.
   - Includes isolated test context runner ensuring zero state leakage between tests.

3. **Headless CLI Verification Script (`test/verify.js`)**:
   - Executable natively via `node test/verify.js`.
   - Zero external npm packages (`node:fs`, `node:path`).
   - Validates file presence, dependency isolation, CDN link absence, contract conformance, and runs all 65 test cases.
   - Exits with return code `0` on 100% pass, and `1` on any failure.

## 6. How to Run the Tests

### Command Line (Headless)
```bash
node test/verify.js
```

### In-Browser (Visual GUI)
Open `test/index.html` directly in any web browser:
```bash
# Windows Chrome
start chrome C:\Users\MNZ\Desktop\Camry_iDrive_Demo\test\index.html

# Windows Edge
start msedge C:\Users\MNZ\Desktop\Camry_iDrive_Demo\test\index.html
```
or double-click `test/index.html` in Windows Explorer.
